transfer.description: Add transactions from a file or download a copy of your records.
transfer.local: Files are processed on your device. Your data is not sent to another service during transfer.
transfer.importDescription: Fill in the template, select your file and review records before adding them.
transfer.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV · Up to 5 MB and 1,000 transactions
transfer.guide: How to fill in the template
transfer.guideText: Keep column headers on the first sheet. Date: YYYY-MM-DD; time: HH:mm. Blank time means 12:00; ties use file/entry order. Legacy files without a time column are supported. Types: BUY, SELL, BONUS, SPLIT, DIVIDEND. For trades, fill in at least two of quantity, unit price and total. Do not use thousands separators. For TRY cash transactions, enter USD per 1 TRY in the USD rate column; bonus and split transactions need no exchange rate. Dividends are the total net cash received. Split ratio: new quantity / old quantity. Status must be empty or ACTIVE. The template contains no sample transactions. If you enter all three amounts, the total difference may not exceed 0.01.
transfer.atomic: If a row is invalid, nothing is added. Duplicate and cancelled (VOIDED) records are skipped. Existing records are unchanged.
transfer.empty: The file contains no transaction rows.
transfer.failed: Could not complete the operation. Check the file and try again.
transfer.balance: Insufficient balance for {{asset}} on {{date}}. No records were added.
transfer.exportDescription: Download transactions within a date range. Excel and CSV contain all fields; PDF contains a readable transaction summary.
